pages.title: Placement
pages.text: Place Bellows adjacent to a Crucible Furnace with the nozzle pointing into it. Light the furnace first. Empty-hand use operates the Bellows. It raises the heat ceiling, not a separate processing-time allowance.

pages.title: Pump and Check
pages.text: A successful survival blow costs one food point (half a hunger icon), with a one-second cooldown shared by that furnace. Failed or cooldown clicks cost nothing. Creative blows are free. Repeated blows refresh the eight-second hold and four-second decay; they never bank unlimited time.
